description.value:
As an action, you can end your active field in a burst whose effect depends on which field was running. Once you've used this feature, you need a long rest before using it again.

Ionizing Burst. Choose up to 10 creatures within 60 feet; each must succeed on a Constitution save or take 14d6 ion damage and become stunned until the start of your next turn (half damage and no stun on a success).

Jamming Burst. Choose up to 10 creatures within 60 feet. Once within the next minute, if a chosen creature would fail a save against a tech power or be hit by an attack power, it may instead succeed on that save or cause the attack to miss.

Targeting Burst. Choose up to 10 creatures within 60 feet; each must succeed on a Constitution save against your tech save DC or be blinded for 1d4+1 turns.
